title: Ceremonia de Boda con Temática de Bosque Onírico: Salón de Jardín Estelar Inmersivo con Arañas de Cristal
prompt: Create a surreal high-end forest-themed wedding ceremony scene featuring a dreamlike immersive garden wedding space. The setting is an indoor ultra-high ceiling ballroom with a central deep perspective wedding aisle captured from a low-angle wide view with axial symmetry composition. The aisle leads to a semicircular stage backdrop at the far end. The aisle surface is highly reflective mirror material that reflects lights and star points. Guest seating on both sides is semi-enclosed by abundant floral arrangements and lush greenery. The ceiling design is crucial: it is completely covered with dense starlight string lights creating a galaxy-like twinkling effect, with multiple European-style crystal chandeliers suspended in air made of transparent layered cascading crystal that catches and refracts light. Large expanses of naturally draping green vines, moss, and flowering plants extend downward from the ceiling creating a 'forest canopy' effect inspired by New Zealand native bush. The stage features a giant glowing full moon installation as the backdrop with soft blue-purple gradient light halo. Natural steps in front of the stage are half-concealed by fresh flowers and greenery. On the right side is a white unicorn sculpture with wings in matte plaster texture evoking fairy tale fantasy. Floral and botanical details include abundant natural-style florals in irregular growth patterns with flowers including white roses, champagne roses, pink blooms, pale lavender flowers, and yellow accent flowers. Greenery includes tree ferns native to New Zealand forests, moss, vines, and wild-feeling native plants like kowhai and pohutukawa branches. Floral heights are staggered creating obvious foreground, middle ground, and background layers. The lighting system is extremely important: overall warm-toned lighting dominates with color temperature around 3200K, starlight and chandeliers provide ambient light, soft stage spotlights project onto the aisle, and hidden atmospheric lights are embedded within floral arrangements creating translucency and spatial depth. The color palette uses forest green, warm gold, and ivory white as primary colors with supporting colors of pale purple, misty blue, and champagne gold. The overall color is soft, romantic, and film-grade color grading. The texture and style convey ultimate realism, hyper-realistic, cinematic lighting and shadow, luxurious yet natural, high-end wedding planning visual aesthetic matching international premier wedding brands. Photography and image quality should be commercial photography grade using a 35mm wide-angle lens with shallow depth of field but overall clarity, HDR high dynamic range, 8K ultra-high definition with rich detail and no noise.
